reviewer.name: acceptance_audit
reviewer.role: Independent semantic assessment; did not generate native candidate content

scope: Assess only actual reached native artifacts and clarification disposition against the original R08 scope. This is a review plan, not a replacement model prompt, generated draft, owner response, test suite or added acceptance gate.
original_R08_criteria: Artifacts are linked to actual prompts/commands and retained first output.
Generation is distinguished from scaffold creation and intentionally seeded faults.
One observed route is sufficient for the tutorial; a second observed route is required before a measured paired comparison is claimed.
provenance_review: Bind the actual native session, invocation, continuation prompt and parent history to exact first completed tool actions and retained artifact bytes.
Separate native-authored write/edit content from copied unchanged templates, input attachments, controller reconstructions and authored reference data.
Keep all first outputs, errors, omissions and subsequent revisions distinct. Report any inability to reconstruct intermediate byte identities.
State that the supplied authored specification and case oracle were exposed; assess this as a disclosed projection rather than blind discovery.

requirement_assessment.statement: For a valid routing decision the explanation MUST present route, reason code and policy version without altering the routing decision.
The explanation MUST explicitly say that a routing recommendation is not payment approval and that payment authorization remains a separate human process.
For invalid or non-positive amounts the explanation MUST report rejection and the INVALID_AMOUNT reason without creating an eligibility recommendation.
The explanation MUST display the policy version from the routing decision and MUST NOT silently infer a newer policy version or threshold.
The alpha MUST treat time savings and user benefit as hypotheses pending observation and MUST NOT report a measured ROI before a field study.

authority_and_readiness_assessment: Check that SRC-POL-001 and BR-001/v1 govern the EUR5000 boundary. Sponsor tickets and the hostile stale wiki do not authorize payment, a new threshold or a policy revision.
Check that the constitution remains an unratified supplied template unless an attributable decision actually exists; no invented ratification, governance approval or human signoff.
Compare checklist claims with the actual specification and evidence. Preserve unmet/unchecked readiness items and disclose unsupported green claims.
Keep user benefit and time/ROI claims as HYPOTHESIS_NOT_VALIDATED; no supplied source establishes a pilot outcome.
owner_questions: Which explanation vocabulary do real operators understand?
Does the interface accidentally induce payment approval?
How will actual user benefit be measured in a pilot?
clarification_review: Identify the exact native output/tool event that actually presents the unresolved owner questions and reaches a wait/clarification disposition, or identify genuine progression if observed. Mere input questions, future intent, empty completion, timeout or controller interruption are not a reached clarification stop. Do not invent owner answers; a real documented stop may complete the bounded journey without implementation or positive human approval.
result_classification: For each inspected obligation report SUPPORTED, OMITTED, CONTRADICTED or UNDETERMINED with exact artifact/session evidence. Distinguish native-artifact quality from original R08 journey completion. A uniformly green checklist or perfect first artifact is not imposed as an extra condition; genuine omissions and rejected outputs must remain visible.
decision_limits: One observed primary route is sufficient; no second framework is required without a measured paired comparison.
No implementation phase, production release, human acceptance, complete billing or empirical benefit is required for this bounded tutorial observation.
No semantic judgment or R08 closure will be recorded before useful native output and actual reached workflow evidence are available.
This independent reviewer will not modify native candidate files or execute a model call.
